items.text: Clearing brain amyloid in early Alzheimer's disease slowed the worsening of a dementia rating over eighteen months by about a quarter, with brain amyloid falling and with infusion reactions and amyloid-related imaging abnormalities in a portion of those on the drug; amyloid pathology rises from about a tenth of people at age fifty to near a half at ninety; and many older people carry abundant plaques and tangles with intact cognition, loss of synapses tracking cognitive decline more closely than plaques do.
items.from: ### Amyloid cleared, decline slowed by a quarter

items.sentence: a neurodegeneration assignments past fields' own mitochondrial observations
items.text: Amyloid-β protects against fungal and bacterial infection, its soluble oligomers binding microbial cell-wall carbohydrates and its fibrils agglutinating and entrapping the microbes, and a brain infection seeds and accelerates amyloid-β deposition that sits with the bacteria; driving fast-spiking interneurons or a light flickering at forty hertz lowers amyloid-β in some brain regions with microglia changing form, and a later work finds no reliable lowering of amyloid load across its models.
items.from: ### Amyloid-β entrapping microbes, and a 40 hertz flicker

items.text: Eligibility for a shingles vaccine set by date of birth, with uptake rising from near nothing to about a half across the cut-off, went with a fall of about a fifth in new dementia diagnoses over seven years, stronger among women, and a follow-up with the same design finds fewer diagnoses of mild cognitive impairment and fewer deaths from dementia.
items.from: ### A shingles vaccine and fewer dementia diagnoses

items.section: 4.2 Clean cuts — where medicine reports no problem

items.text: In the liver about nine tenths of a paracetamol dose passes to conjugation and about a tenth is oxidized to the reactive NAPQI, which glutathione conjugates to compounds passed in urine; in overdose above about 150 mg/kg glutathione is depleted, NAPQI binds the liver cells' own proteins and the cells die, and N-acetylcysteine within the first hours restores glutathione and lowers mortality from about a twentieth to under a hundredth.
items.from: ### Paracetamol in the liver, glutathione used up

items.text: Placebo knee surgery of skin incisions and a simulated procedure improved pain and function as much as real arthroscopic débridement or lavage over two years; and across surgical trials against a placebo procedure the placebo arm improved in about three quarters, with surgery doing better than placebo in about half, generally by a small margin.
items.from: ### Sham surgery improving alike with real surgery

items.text: Against a placebo procedure, coronary stenting for single-vessel disease gave no clear gain in exercise time in one trial of patients on about three anti-anginal drugs, and in another trial of patients off all antianginal medication it lowered angina and left about three times as many free of angina.
items.from: ### Stenting against a placebo procedure, two trials

items.text: A weekly GLP-1 analogue beside lifestyle change lowered body weight by about a seventh against a fortieth on placebo, and lowered the alcohol drunk and cigarettes smoked; a year after the drug stopped about two thirds of the weight loss had returned and the cardiometabolic gains reverted toward their starting values.
items.from: ### Semaglutide at weight, alcohol and cigarettes

items.sentence: early-life exposure tracking later allergic and metabolic disease
items.text: Children on traditional farms have about four times less asthma and six times less allergic sensitization than genetically similar children on industrialized farms, with house-dust endotoxin about seven times higher and innate immune cells differing, and farm-house dust extracts given into mice's noses suppress allergic airway disease through innate immune pathways; and hay fever is less common in children with more older siblings.

items.sentence: early-life exposure tracking later allergic and metabolic disease
items.text: Introducing peanut early in infancy to infants with eczema or egg allergy lowered peanut allergy at five years from about a seventh to a fiftieth among those with a negative skin test at entry; and infant gut bacteria differ between populations, early dominance by Bacteroides going with more autoimmunity and allergy and one bacterium's lipopolysaccharide bringing less innate immune activation.
items.from: ### Early peanut, and an infant gut's first bacteria

items.text: Anaesthetic potency measured in tadpoles rises nearly linearly with the oil-to-water partition coefficient across alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, ethers and esters, and ceases to rise past a chain length of about thirteen carbons; xenon, a noble gas forming no ordinary bonds, anaesthetizes animals and people; and a pure soluble protein, firefly luciferase, is inhibited by half at anaesthetic concentrations essentially identical to those that anaesthetize animals across a hundred-thousand-fold range of potencies, the anaesthetics competing with its substrate.
items.from: ### Anaesthetic potency following oil solubility, and xenon

items.sentence: Something going inward, and an outward instrument unable to reach it, which is why unresponsiveness stands in place of a state and selves report experience from under it.
items.text: Mimosa leaves, pea tendrils, Venus flytraps and sundew traps lose their autonomous and touch-induced movements under anaesthetics and recover within minutes, the flytrap's loss coming from blocked action potentials; induction of anaesthesia and emergence from it follow different concentrations, the half-effect of induction above two and a half times that of emergence for one agent; and reversal of anaesthesia by high pressure appears in some species and conditions alone.
items.from: ### Plants made still by anaesthetics, and a lag in waking

items.text: Paracetamol is deacetylated in the brain and spinal cord and joined to the body's own arachidonic acid to make AM404, a potent TRPV1 agonist that also blocks the sodium channels NaV1.7 and NaV1.8 at nanomolar amounts, and this joining and the pain relief are absent in animals lacking the joining enzyme or TRPV1.
items.from: ### Paracetamol joined to the body's own fatty acid

items.text: Paracetamol at a gram, no better than placebo for acute low back pain, lowers a person's empathy for others' physical and social pain, and over three weeks lowers self-reported social pain and the brain responses to social rejection, physical and social pain coming with one same coupling.
items.from: ### Paracetamol at the back, and at felt empathy

items.text: Of drug programmes entering phase I about a tenth reach approval, and a twentieth in oncology, the lowest disease area; and of a thousand experimental acute-stroke treatments the hundred-odd carried into people were no more effective in experiments than the nine hundred tested in animals alone, the acute-stroke treatments that work reopening the blocked vessel.
items.from: ### One drug in ten reaching approval

items.text: Gene expression of human trauma, burn and endotoxin conditions correlate with one another and poorly with the matching mouse models; more first-in-class small-molecule medicines over a decade came from phenotypic screening than from target-based approaches; and new drugs approved per inflation-adjusted research dollar have halved about every nine years since 1950, a roughly eightyfold fall.
items.from: ### Mouse and person, phenotypic screening, and falling yield

items.text: A desert iguana raises its body temperature about two degrees after bacterial infection and survives more often when it can reach that temperature, an antipyretic that prevents the rise raising deaths; and most human rhinovirus replicates better at the cool nasal temperature of thirty-three to thirty-five degrees than at thirty-seven, in part through a weaker antiviral interferon response of the infected cells at the cool temperature.
items.from: ### Fever sought by lizards, a virus in a cool nose

items.text: Paracetamol each six hours for fever in critically ill patients with infection changed neither the fever-free days nor the deaths; and a model of published data estimates that suppressing fever raises influenza cases and deaths, by about a twentieth for seasonal and a hundredth for pandemic influenza, through more virus shed and more movement while contagious.
items.from: ### Fever brought down in the critically ill

items.text: GLP-1, a hormone of thirty amino acids made in the gut's L-cells and released at meals, raises glucose-dependent insulin, slows gut motility and curbs appetite, and is broken down within about two minutes; and a GLP-1 analogue with two amino-acid changes and a fatty-acid moiety binds albumin and resists degradation, lasting about a week in the plasma for once-weekly dosing.
items.from: ### GLP-1 after a meal, minutes and a week
